title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future

meta.Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Line: Morinomiya Revue - Theatre

rows.Speaker: Swordsman
rows.Line:
“This swordsmanship...!
You are no mere ogre, are you?!”

rows.Speaker: Ogre
rows.Line: “Hah! I have long since forgotten about my past!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Whoaaa...!
Their swords are going all cling-clang-clash!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Their blades look like they're dancing, but they sound so solid whenever they meet.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is quite the spectacle...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (After learning more about sword fighting with Mikazukigumi, I have a much greater appreciation for just how difficult it is to move with such speed and precision.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The director must've put quite a lot of effort into making this scene feel so compelling.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You can tell that the costumes are meant to flutter a certain way.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're also amazing singers. The all-female Suzurangumi troupe really wows you with their beauty and charm, while this one seems to be more about power and action...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There's more to it than just the fact that they're all boys. I mean, they're all performing at such a high level...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is so cool...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I didn't know Kikyogumi was so amazing...!!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooowww...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was an excellent performance...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. The scene at the end where the swordsman and the ogre part ways under the cherry blossoms... It was sad, but I like how they left room for them meeting again someday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I noticed a few people in the audience tearing up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In the beginning, they fought like only one of them would be left standing... I feel that the final scene was so moving because they presented us with such an epic battle.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Everyone in the audience really got to understand the swordsman and ogre's feelings!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (For some reason, there were a lot of empty seats...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Even though they put on such an amazing show.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, we've been talking for quite a while now. We mustn't overstay our welcome...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That being said, I'd love to discuss further. Why don't we all find a place where we can resume this conversation?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try the diner by the station?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sounds good. I could use a bite.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, then... Let's go!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew...
We really chatted up a storm.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Talking about all our favorite scenes was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I also had fun.
It's been a while since we got to talk like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it has! After all, Rui and I are training with the boys, you're with the girls, Nene, and you've been learning all about management, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Speaking of which, what are you guys working on right now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tap dancing, until just recently.
We'll be having lessons on traditional Japanese dance soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys get to learn about so many different things!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How to put it... Things have felt a bit hectic lately.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For some reason, our teachers are constantly getting swapped in and out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nothing like that's been happening on my end. What do you think is going on...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We have no idea...
But I for one have been enjoying the chance to learn from so many different instructors.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Each one focuses on the aspects they see as most important. In other words, we get to tackle a subject from many different angles.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that is kinda nice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Just like taiyaki shops.
They're all really good, but also taste a little different!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That seems like an apt comparison.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What about you, Emu?
It seems like you're always doing something different. I remember you learning about being a producer one day and how to write proposals the next.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, lately, I've been learning a lot about budgeting for day-to-day operations.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All the stuff about employee wages and maintenance costs are things I've heard about when it comes to Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But Morinomiya puts a lot of resources into their props and costumes because they want their audiences to “experience the extraordinary”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
In other words, resources are allocated differently depending on what a company wishes to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. It's been a lot to process, but I've also been having a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like you've been gaining quite a lot from this experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Lots and lots of people at both Morinomiya and Phoenix Wonderland are working really hard to put smiles on everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Some problems are really, really hard to solve, and you sorta just have to take a leap of faith...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I wanna become somebody who can help solve those kinds of problems.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why I'm really enjoying what I'm doing right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, also!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The other day, when I was learning about administrative practices... Oh, wait!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...?
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So...
That just reminded me of something...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I saw this really strange girl the other day!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A strange girl? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, there's this really fancy room where the executives hold their most important meetings...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And this girl around our age came walking out of it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She was in their meeting room?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Was she there as an official participant...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's hard to believe that someone our age would be engaging with any executives.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu is a bit of an exception, and I feel that we would've heard about such a girl through word of mouth by now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe some of the other Morinomiya students could give us a clue...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This might actually be the perfect time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... There's someone that I want you guys to meet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's a classmate and showed a lot of interest in our troupe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She might know something, so wanna try asking her?
A few days later
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, it looks like we're the first ones here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It's not quite the time we agreed upon yet, so let's...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Wheeeeeeee!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Tsukasa, Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Emu. Hello.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, wait, wait! What were you doing on top of that tree?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I was running a little late because of some class rep business, so I decided to take the short way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It looks pretty tall to me!
Honestly...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, you didn't have to do that since Nene and her friend aren't here yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, we are all ten minutes early.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Then, I'm glad I made it in time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to meet Nene's friend. I wonder what she's like!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What was her name? Byakkomachi...?
She's keen on learning more about Wonderlands×Showtime, so she must have an eye for talent!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She sounds like a very avid student.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She even asked to meet us at Phoenix Wonderland because she wants to learn as much as she can from the night show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ I really hope she enjoys it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, you guys!
Hello. You must be Kusanagi's friends.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Nice to meet you all. My name is Suzu Byakkomachi, and I need to thank you for this wonderful opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Kusanagi's told me all about Wonderlands×Showtime. I've been hoping to meet you for quite a while now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's heeeeerrrrr!!!!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Wh-What...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I see.
You saw me leaving that meeting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I was really far away, but I saw someone with perfect posture!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was you, right, Suzu?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Suzu...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Emu, you shouldn't start calling her by her first name so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I was only a little surprised, since not many people do call me by it.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Please feel free to use whichever you prefer, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, Suzu!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry for getting us sidetracked.
Where were we...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I was definitely the person you saw that day, Otori, since I was scheduled to meet with the board then.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: That being said...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I would greatly appreciate it if you could all keep this between us.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'd like for everyone at the academy to treat me like any other actor or actress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay, got it...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it's incredible to think that a student is being given an opportunity to be involved with how Morinomiya is run...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
It is incredible.
I'm very grateful to Grandfather for giving me this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Grandfather?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Oh, he's the chairman of the board of the Morinomiya Revue.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The chairman?!
Of the board?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I understand, Morinomiya's chairman is quite the businessman...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I remember reading about how he became the chairman of the board after spending time as the president or one of the executives at several major companies...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
That's right.
When he was young, he apparently had a reputation for being a ruthless manager.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But he was actually a Morinomiya fan long before he ever became the board chair.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: He even used to take me to see shows with him when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You went with your grandpa...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I've always loved how dazzling Morinomiya's shows are. I wanted to stand in the spotlight on that stage...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: My family wanted me to enter the world of business, but then my grandfather said, “Why not try both...?”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Initially, all I did was sit in on some meetings. But I've been getting more and more opportunities lately to express my opinions regarding proposals, advertisements and such.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I remember hearing about a recent ticket campaign running on Morinomiya's social media...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Oh, that was actually my idea.
It was the result of us trying to get more young people to come see Morinomiya's shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's amazing, Suzu!!!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm also learning a lot about management and stuff right now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My grandpa was the one who founded Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm doing everything I can to make it a place that's filled with smiling guests!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Your grandfather...?
You mentioned that your last name is Otori. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, we also forget from time to time...
Her family runs the Otori Group.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
That explains why you're learning more about management...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But my brothers are always telling me how my ideas aren't practical.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When Phoenix Wonderland was having trouble attracting guests, I couldn't come up with any good ideas to turn things around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I think you're really amazing, Suzu!
You're actually balancing your dreams with reality and making things work with everyone at Morinomiya!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna be just like you! I want to learn to do what you do as fast as I possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Just like me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: No, never mind...
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: Daddy! The night show's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We've been chatting for quite a while now.
Why don't we find a good place to watch the show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Let's go, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yeah...
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Just now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Suzu seemed kinda sad for some reason...)
The next day
Morinomiya Revue - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me put everything away like this, Ms. Otori...

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: I really appreciate it since there was just so much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Not a problem!
I have a much better understanding of what general affairs involves now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll be more than happy to lend a hand if you need help with anything else!

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line:
Oh... Hehe.
You're even more energetic than usual.

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line:
But you can clock out for the day.
I'll see you again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you! See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you again.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (General affairs deals with so many different things.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I guess every company is different, but you have to help set up meetings, keep track of all the equipment in the building and all sorts of other stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I'll read over my notes again after I get home!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wonder how Suzu learned about management...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I should ask her the next time I see her.)
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't remember coming this way...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: U-Uhhh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which way did I come from?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What do I do...?!
I think I went the wrong way while I was thinking about everything I've been learning...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uhhhh... How about this way?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Huh? That looks like...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you again for making the time to meet with me.

rows.Speaker: Board Member
rows.Line: Ah, not a problem. Still...

rows.Speaker: Board Member
rows.Line: It is unfortunate to hear that Kikyogumi is going to be disbanded.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What...?)

rows.Speaker: Board Member
rows.Line:
Try not to worry too much.
These sorts of decisions are sometimes necessary to ensure the longevity of a company.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Board Member
rows.Line: Please let us know if you'd like to speak with me again. For now, you'll need to excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Of course.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: These decisions are sometimes necessary...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Kikyogumi is being disbanded...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Wh-Wh-Wh-What's going on here?!
We just saw them perform the other day...)
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Otori? What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... I got lost after helping put away a few things.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then just now, I...! Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Let's find a place where we can talk, shall we...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: No one is scheduled to use this rehearsal room right now.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Anyway, Otori, about what you just heard...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really sorry!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't mean to eavesdrop or anything...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But is it true? Kikyogumi is really being disbanded?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes. The board reached a consensus yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
But things haven't been fully finalized yet.
So, please refrain from telling anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But why...?
Kikyogumi's shows are so amazing...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Ah, that's right. You've seen them perform...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Then, did anything stand out to you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Stand out?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, for example... The number of empty seats.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was such a great show, so I did wonder why there were all those empty seats.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In order to give a proper explanation, I'll probably need to start with how the Kikyogumi troupe initially came to be...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Which may take a while. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, please go on!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The Morinomiya Revue and Suzurangumi were simultaneously established a hundred years ago.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: This company has spent decades establishing the Morinomiya brand of shows. As such, its fan base has become rock solid.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's also grown stagnant.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, so... They have a lot of fans coming to see their shows, but not many new ones...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Nothing serious has happened yet, but we'll slowly but surely keep fading from the public eye if we let things go on like this.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Kikyogumi was established two years ago with the precise intent of getting ahead of this issue.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The goal was essentially to bring in a new set of fans and breathe new life into Morinomiya by forming an all-male troupe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However, Kikyogumi is still a very new troupe that's full of young members.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Compared to Suzurangumi, they're lacking in terms of quality... Showgoers have seen reviews of that nature going around, and as a result, the troupe is struggling to bring in the expected earnings.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If a product fails to hit sales targets, then the company must cease producing it.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: And what's more...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: All of Kikyogumi's leads and star-level talent just keep leaving for greener pastures.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Wh-Why...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Wouldn't you want to leave if you were in their shoes?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You push yourself to the absolute limit during practice, but it doesn't fill the seats. On top of that, you're seen as lesser than Suzurangumi. I honestly don't blame them for wanting to leave.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Improving the brand while short-staffed is impossibly difficult. As such, there's no reason to expect an increase in earnings. In other words, the board was right to disband them.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I understand their reasoning. But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu, it sounds like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You don't want to give up on them, do you?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
No, I don't...
Because I believe they're a vital part of Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The younger fans find a slight lack of refinement actually charming. When it comes to reaching a new audience, this troupe has been able to produce results.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Plus, the remaining troupe members and the male students are all very passionate about what they do.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Which is why I want to see if we can keep them somehow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's always hard when you can't reach your goal or protect the things you care about...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That reminds me of Phoenix Wonderland not too long ago.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can I help you save them?!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I really understand why you want to help Kikyogumi not get disbanded...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, they put on these amazing performances that feel totally different from the ones Suzurangumi does...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There were empty seats, but the people who did come to see them all seemed to really enjoy themselves!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, sorry...! I'm an outsider, so I probably shouldn't be saying all this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The thing is, Phoenix Wonderland went through something similar a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We started losing guests...
We tried doing a lot of new things, but nothing worked at first.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, I'm studying management and how to run an organization right now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I want to help you in any way I can, Suzu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Please, let me help you...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Otori...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: It is nice knowing that I have an ally...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Me too!
A few days later
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (How do we save Kikyogumi from being disbanded...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They're making that announcement in three weeks, so we gotta come up with something before then.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Let's see... What if we got robots like Robo-Nene to replace any troupe members that left?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, she can do all sorts of things like jumping really high and moving super fast.)

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Line: Otori, please enter.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Pardon me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nice to meet you all. My name is Emu Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you very much for taking time out of your busy schedules to hear our presentation today.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: As in, the Otori zaibatsu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes. As fortune would have it, I am currently being allowed to study management here at the Morinomiya Revue.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (I had just as much trouble believing it when we practiced together, but... She seems like a completely different person.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (She looks so dignified. She clearly has the board's attention now.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're here today to present a plan for revitalizing Kikyogumi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Currently, they're in a dire situation in terms of revenue and manpower.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: However, there is no arguing with the fact that they have succeeded in their primary goal of appealing to a new demographic.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: First, we'd like for you all to take a look at the data we've passed out, along with the following slide.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: This looks like... The attendance data for the Suzurangumi and Kikyogumi troupes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes. As I'm sure you're all already aware, when compared with Suzurangumi, Kikyogumi garners much more support from younger fans.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That is partially due to the troupe members being much younger overall compared to Suzurangumi. And while they have their flaws, their passion and energy more than make up for it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Unfortunately, high ticket prices are preventing new and existing fans from attending.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We believe this is the first problem that must be remedied.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Yes, but... We can't just blindly lower ticket prices since that'll result in a drop in revenue.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Right... I can't imagine that it'll lead to an increase in attendance when we're already hemorrhaging star-level talent.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All true. However...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We want you all to see this as an opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: An opportunity? Care to elaborate...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course. What we mean is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The spots left behind by the troupe's recent departures can be filled by some of the students at the academy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The skill gap between the top tier of the boys and the current troupe members is virtually nonexistent.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In other words, the odds of seeing a significant drop in performance quality are just that low.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: But there may be a small drop. You can't guarantee a seamless transition...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Of course. But any growing pains will subside with time.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The boys will feel more motivated if they're given the chance to perform on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The more they perform on stage, the more your students stand to grow.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: They may be Morinomiya students, but it still seems...

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line:
No audience would have that!
Surely you're aware that they want to see professionals perform?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes. So, we'd lay the groundwork by making a point of it in the promotional material.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We might describe it as the trial run of a new show format featuring the best our academy has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Naturally, as this is an experiment, we'll offer tickets at lower prices. The audience should then be able to watch high-quality performances without having to shoulder any further burden.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: So long as our audiences understand the experimental nature of the endeavor, we can prevent any concerns about erosion of the Morinomiya brand.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: It's been challenging to get Kikyogumi's core fans to return to see shows due to how much younger they are coupled with the high ticket prices that have been set...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Lowering prices will make it much easier for them to come back.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: We may be able to make regulars out of a young demographic that was previously unfamiliar with Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: This is an opportunity to make an investment for the future and expand your consumer base.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line:
It's an intriguing idea...
But will it actually work?

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: At the moment, people don't exactly hold Kikyogumi in high regard. Even if they began trying something new, their current reputation is likely to control the conversation.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: True. Your plan may not pose much risk to our branding...

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: But some fans will undoubtedly be against this.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: As for them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We can't guarantee success.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We still believe this idea is worth putting into practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There is no right answer to this problem.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But doing nothing is not an option.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why you all must choose how you're going to blaze a new trail in completely unfamiliar territory.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The Kikyogumi fans believe in this troupe's future. They want to be there alongside their favorite performers as they grow...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: They do not stand to lose anything from this idea.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We ask that you please give us just a small amount of time to run this experiment...!

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Still, we can't let students perform and risk ruining Morinomiya's reputation!

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line:
I agree...
And even if we see an increase in attendance, we can't expect stable earnings...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We knew this wasn't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (But we can't give up. Not now. Not yet.)

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Actually, I think the benefits outweigh the risks...

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: I agree... At the very least, something just doesn't seem right about disbanding the troupe right away.

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Yes, and trying out a new system may get people talking...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: They seem genuinely interested.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I think we managed to get through to them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!
Two months later
Morinomiya Revue - Theatre

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Hey, wanna try doing some acting with me?”

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “Huh? Why are you asking me...?”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Because our fates were sealed the second we were born into nobility. We don't have a choice.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “But I don't plan on being tied down like this forever. Doesn't it just bore you out of your mind?”

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “I mean...”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
“We can be whatever we want on stage!
And I know you'd love it.”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Huh...
Are those boys on stage students?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Probably. I've never seen them before...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: They really have me on the edge of my seat.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: “Hey, don't you all know that it's past curfew?!”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Whoa, busted! Guys, run!!”
se_run_men_002_4

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “This is why I said that we shouldn't hold practice so late at night!”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: “Stop right this second!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize that actor could play such a comical character...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me neither.
This is a little different from what we're used to, but I kinda like it.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “This is it. Our very first showing.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Yeah. We managed to make it this far.”

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “I have to think that even you're feeling nervous right now.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “No way! If anything, I've never been more excited.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “I mean, we're about to go out there and put on an unforgettable performance for everyone.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Okay, that's the end...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (How's the crowd going to...?)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Wow. They're getting a standing ovation...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line:
<That concludes this showing.
Please be sure not to forget any of your belongings.>
Morinomiya Revue - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That was a spectacular performance...!
So this is the new show format Kikyogumi will be trying!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At a school for the children of nobles, a group of outcasts forms a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist was thought to have the worst acting skills in the troupe, but he hid the fact that he was the prince of the neighboring land... I particularly liked that bit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! And I was moved by each cast member's powerful acting performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too... The veterans were obviously really good...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But the students really held their own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. Of course, they were a little rough around the edges...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that ended up being just one more reason for the audience to cheer them on.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Very true! I learned a lot by watching them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I was hoping to tell Emu and Byakkomachi my thoughts on the show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, yes!
They were sitting in the section for invited guests, but where could they be...?

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: You guys!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Hello. It's been a little while.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What did you think of the new Kikyogumi?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was absolutely astonishing!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The show we saw before involved pulling the audience into the world of the story by way of masterful acting, precision action and extraordinary singing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But the show we just saw involved a different kind of energy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. While the veterans used their talents to skillfully set up the story, the students used their youthful energy to grab the audience's attention.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The best of both halves meshed together seamlessly to create something greater... That was my impression, at least.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like they grew with each passing second, you know? I really enjoyed watching that happen live...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, Emu, ever since we began training at Morinomiya, we knew that you were keeping an extremely busy schedule...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But none of us thought that you were working on such a massive project.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry for not telling you guys sooner.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Ever since the board approved our idea, my heart wouldn't stop racing... All the way up until today.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That was so good! I think I'm a fan of all of them now!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Me too! I didn't know the students here were such amazing actors!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I know, right?! And they're probably gonna just keep growing from here. The tickets aren't too pricey, either, so I think I'll be back really soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All the guests are smiling and laughing.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I just received word that all tickets are projected to be sold out through the final showing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes. And after the reviews started going around...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: It appears that more Suzurangumi fans are beginning to warm up to Kikyogumi.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Instead of comparing the two troupes, they're starting to see them as entirely different forms of entertainment.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
That's great!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Longtime fans of Morinomiya, and people who just discovered this place...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is it safe to say we managed to make both groups happy?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I think so.
But we still have a list of problems left to tackle...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Some in management are saying that people are only reacting superficially to something slightly new.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: So, we have to keep doing everything possible to show that the success this show achieved can be repeated.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound so excited, Suzu☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just happen to know the perfect spell that'll help you work even harder!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The perfect spell?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Won-Won-Wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: What did you do just now, Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is a great way to give yourself a boost of energy and get more motivated to work harder!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know you're probably gonna encounter lots and lots more obstacles in the future...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll do just fine, Suzu!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You really are an interesting person.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what you'll dream of next, and how you'll make it come true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu is in charge of coming up with dreams for our troupe, after all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, why are you acting so proud?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I could ask you the same thing, Nene. You seem awfully happy for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean...
I'm happy that my friend just got praised...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Suzu, Tsukasa, Rui, Nene and everyone from the audience... They're all smiling.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I really love it when this happens...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone's having fun and I get to see their sparkly smiles.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We had to overcome a lot of different hurdles to get here...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(And I'm probably gonna get stuck again.
I'll feel like giving up.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to be someone who keeps on trying.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something just now, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nope☆ Nothing!
